newsitem.title: FRANCE: Top cops on trial for complicity in drugs running.
newsitem.headline: Top cops on trial for complicity in drugs running.

text.p: Two of France's top police detectives appeared in a Paris appeals court on Monday in a bid to overturn prison sentences passed against them last year for complicity in drugs running.

Philippe Feval, deputy head of a police unit specialised in cracking down on major gangland activity and his own deputy, Thierry Dentz, were respectively sentenced in July to four and three years imprisonement.
They were found guilty of complicity in a drugs traffic involved 1.5 tonnes of cannabis and 80 kilos (175 lbs) of heroin.
Feval, who has always denied guilt, claims he was framed by colleagues from the main police anti-drugs unit and is expected to repeat his accusations when he testifies on Tuesday.
The central figure in the case, Paris restaurant owner Roland Plegat, was sentenced to 20 years imprisonement.
